en.headline: Observatory expects generally fine and dry weather for the work week
en.dek: An anticyclone aloft will bring sunny conditions from Monday to Friday, with daytime temperatures around 30 to 32 degrees and only isolated light rain patches later in the week.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory said an anticyclone aloft will bring generally fine weather to southern China this week, with the northeast monsoon moderating gradually over the next couple of days.
From Monday to Wednesday the weather is expected to be fine and dry during the day, with temperatures ranging from 26 to 32 degrees Celsius. Tuesday is forecast to be hot in the afternoon.

On Thursday and Friday the Observatory expects sunny periods with one or two light rain patches, mainly in the morning or at night, and temperatures of 26 to 31 degrees. Winds will strengthen to force 4 to 5 at times.
Relative humidity is forecast to stay between 55 and 85 per cent. No significant rainfall is expected through the work week. The yellow fire danger warning remains in force.

zh.headline: 天文台料本周工作日大致天晴乾燥
zh.dek: 高空反氣旋影響下，周一至周五普遍天晴，日間氣溫約30至32度，周中後期或有一兩陣微雨。
body: 香港天文台表示，高空反氣旋會為華南帶來普遍晴朗天氣，影響沿岸的東北季候風未來一兩日逐漸緩和。
周一至周三預料天晴，日間乾燥，氣溫介乎26至32度，其中周二日間炎熱。
周四及周五則有陽光，早上及晚間或有一兩陣微雨，氣溫26至31度，風力有時達4至5級。
相對濕度預料維持在55%至85%之間，本周顯著降雨機會低。黃色火災危險警告仍然生效。
